ms.promise:
The output is a set of standalone scripts along with docker images that will enable one to setup a Blockfrost cluster.
The scripts will be called by one main wizard script that will guide you thought the process of setting up the cluster.
The cluster, depending on use cases, are typically consisting of services:
・Cardano node
・Cardano DB sync
・Ogmios
・Posgresql (to store data)
・Blockfrost API
ms.criteria: The success is to have a working script to perform the tasks above.
ms.report: Github repository with code and documentation
